name: file-upload-panel
title: File upload panel
description: Drag-and-drop zone with accept/reject MIME feedback (demonstrated in the Labels preview), a Browse button, type and size validation, and a file list with progress, retry and remove. Optional labels?: Partial<FileUploadPanelLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). No provider preserves English; fixtures and caller content stay unchanged. Interactive preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=file-upload-panel--labels.
author: gntik-ai
